question: A student claims that solid sodium chloride consists of separate NaCl molecules. Which response is best supported?

options.B: Correct; the formula NaCl shows that one sodium atom is bonded only to one chlorine atom.

explanation: Ionic solids are extended 3-D arrays of cations and anions; the formula unit is the simplest ratio of ions.

options.A: Correct; ion size is the only factor that changes lattice energy in ionic compounds.
options.B: Incorrect; MgO has the smaller lattice energy because its ions have larger charges that repel.
